schema.subject: SendMessage-tool
schema.tool_overview: name: SendMessage availability: "requires CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1" description: | Sends a message to an agent team teammate, or resumes a subagent by its agent ID. Stopped subagents auto-resume in the background. delivery: automatic delivery_notes: | Messages are delivered automatically to recipients — no polling required. "when teammates send messages, they're delivered automatically to recipients. The lead doesn't need to poll for updates." addressing: | The lead assigns every teammate a name when it spawns them. Any teammate can message any other by that name. Teammates can also be addressed by agent ID. source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Context and communication / Teammate messaging fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00
schema.tool_parameter: role: recipient type: string required: true unknown_in_official_docs: false description: | Identifies the target of the message. Can be a teammate name (assigned by the lead at spawn time) or an agent ID. notes: | "The lead assigns every teammate a name when it spawns them, and any teammate can message any other by that name." Agent IDs are also accepted per the tools-reference description: "Sends a message to an agent team teammate, or resumes a subagent by its agent ID." source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Context and communication / Teammate messaging fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00 schema_source: method: ToolSearch JSONSchema fetch observed_at: 2026-04-28 schema_excerpt: | "to": { "type": "string", "description": "Recipient: teammate name" }

role: message body type: string | structured_object required: true unknown_in_official_docs: false description: | The message to send. For normal communication: a plain text string. For protocol coordination (shutdown and plan-approval flows): a structured object with a `type` discriminator field.
Structured variants: - shutdown_request: { type: "shutdown_request", reason?: string } - shutdown_response: { type: "shutdown_response", request_id: string, approve: boolean, reason?: string } - plan_approval_response: { type: "plan_approval_response", request_id: string, approve: boolean, feedback?: string } caveats: - "When message is a plain text string, the `summary` param is required (see below)" - "Schema uses anyOf — the type field on structured objects acts as a discriminator" - "additionalProperties: false on each variant — no extra fields accepted" notes: | Exact key name resolved 2026-04-28 via ToolSearch: the parameter is `message`, not `content`, `text`, or `body`. The prior schema had this marked unknown_in_official_docs. source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Context and communication / Teammate messaging fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00 schema_source: method: ToolSearch JSONSchema fetch observed_at: 2026-04-28 schema_excerpt: | "message": { "anyOf": [ { "type": "string" }, { "anyOf": [ { "type": "object", "required": ["type"], "properties": { "type": {"const":"shutdown_request"}, "reason": {"type":"string"} } }, { "type": "object", "required": ["type","request_id","approve"], "properties": { "type": {"const":"shutdown_response"}, "request_id": {"type":"string"}, "approve": {"type":"boolean"}, "reason": {"type":"string"} } }, { "type": "object", "required": ["type","request_id","approve"], "properties": { "type": {"const":"plan_approval_response"}, "request_id": {"type":"string"}, "approve": {"type":"boolean"}, "feedback": {"type":"string"} } } ]} ] }

role: UI preview type: string required: conditional (required when message is a plain text string) unknown_in_official_docs: false description: | A 5-10 word summary shown as a preview in the UI. schema.broadcast_note:
status: NOT_A_PARAMETER — OFFICIALLY DOCUMENTED AS MULTI-CALL PATTERN description: | Broadcast (sending to all teammates) is implemented by calling SendMessage once per recipient, not via a parameter. The live official docs (fetched 2026-04-28) now explicitly state this:
"To reach everyone, send one message per recipient." — https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams §Context and communication
The cached source (official-agent-teams.md) mentioned broadcast as a concept ("broadcast: send to all teammates simultaneously") but did NOT include this clarification. The schema's additionalProperties: false with exactly three fields (to, message, summary) corroborates: no broadcast parameter exists. notes_for_skill: | When a skill user wants to broadcast, generate a loop or list of SendMessage calls, one per teammate name. Warn that costs scale with team size. cached_source_quote: | "broadcast: send to all teammates simultaneously. Use sparingly, as costs scale with team size." — official-agent-teams.md §Context and communication (cached) live_source_quote: | "To reach everyone, send one message per recipient." — https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams §Context and communication (2026-04-28) resolution: official — live docs confirm multi-call pattern
schema.availability_caveat: flag_required: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS flag_value: "1" description: | SendMessage (along with all agent team functionality) is only available when the experimental flag is set.
